local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local core=require('openmw.core')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=-1;local stepStart=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during real Wellspring Iron Arrow retrieval')
 print('ArrowDrop stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x17829))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local arrow=nil
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.items) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x17829) and obj.count>0 then arrow=obj;break end end
 if not arrow then print('ArrowDrop world absent');return end
 local box=arrow:getBoundingBox();local origin=camera.getPosition();local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))
 if not stepStart then stepStart=self.position end
 local walked=self.position-stepStart
 local walkedDistance=math.sqrt(walked.x*walked.x+walked.y*walked.y)
 print('ArrowDrop step sample distance='..walkedDistance)
 if walkedDistance>=15 then print('ArrowDrop ordinary step complete') end
 print('ArrowDrop player='..tostring(self.position)..' root='..tostring(arrow.position)..' center='..tostring(box.center)..' half='..tostring(box.halfSize))
 local dv=box.center-self.position;local yaw=math.atan2(view.y*dv.x-view.x*dv.y,view.x*dv.x+view.y*dv.y)
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue arrow walk aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),0))
 if math.sqrt(dv.x*dv.x+dv.y*dv.y)<10 then print('VilverinContinue arrow close') end
 local aim=nil
 for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
  for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
   for _,z in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
    local point=box.center+util.vector3(x*box.halfSize.x,y*box.halfSize.y,z*box.halfSize.z)
    local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,point,{{ignore=self}})
    if hit.hitObject==arrow then aim=hit.hitPos;break end
   end
   if aim then break end
  end
  if aim then break end
 end
 if not aim then print('ArrowDrop no visible bounds point');aim=box.center end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue arrow item aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5)))))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 print('ArrowDrop focus='..tostring(ray.hitObject)..' point='..tostring(ray.hitPos))
 if ray.hitObject==arrow and ray.hitPos then
 print('ArrowDrop visible focus eyeDistance='..(ray.hitPos-origin):length()..' playerDistance='..(ray.hitPos-self.position):length()..' setting='..tostring(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist'))..' thirdDistance='..camera.getThirdPersonDistance())
 if (ray.hitPos-origin):length()<tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')) then print('ArrowDrop in native range') end
 end
end}}}}
